crossRefs.note: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by…
that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

translations.web: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
translations.bsb: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
translations.kjv: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
translations.asv: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.
